verdict.rationale: Yapily documents bulk payments: a dedicated bulk payment authorisation endpoint, plus the getting-started guide naming bulk among the payment types available through the direct API (but not Hosted Pages). Beyond payments, the only multi-item behaviour is a get-accounts call returning all accounts and balances for a consent, which is a list read rather than a bulk operation. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond payments (e.g. batch data retrieval or batch consent management), details on bulk payment limits and per-item status handling, bulk support in Hosted Pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
